New Vice-Chancellor Appointed to Punjab Agricultural University

Dr. Harvinder Singh Dhaliwal has been appointed as the new Vice-Chancellor of Punjab Agricultural University in Ludhiana. Dhaliwal is credited as the developer of new varieties of kinnow, banana, and amla.
